# Error Handling Checklist: Mission Control Product-Line Seed and Flag Activation

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009B requirements and plan artifacts fully define fail-closed preflight behavior, operator-owned cleanup, workflow-contract failure handling, and safe retry semantics.
**Created**: 2026-05-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are non-Mission-Control residue classes fully enumerated for projects, linked tasks, GitHub repo config, issue-sync cron state, OpenClaw/gateway GitHub automation or product-line binding evidence, and FocusEngine live project evidence, while allowing runtime agent inventory by itself? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-027, Data Model §Cleanup Residue]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the blocked-preflight error contract complete, including `code`, `mutation_status: "not_mutated"`, redacted residue summaries, cleanup checklist reference, and no automatic deletion? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Blocked Preflight Result]
- [ ] CHK003 Are FocusEngine cleanup requirements complete enough to keep cleanup operator-owned and backup/export-first across project state, tickets, GitHub sync, OpenClaw/gateway GitHub automation or product-line binding targets, and issue-sync cron targets while retaining runtime agents unless separately decommissioned? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is workflow-contract failure behavior defined for incomplete, stale, missing-slug, or invalid contract readiness before runtime workflow policy is applied? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Contract Readiness Failure]
- [ ] CHK005 Are seed retry and rerun failure scenarios covered for stable Product Line, department, assignment, workflow, flag, governance, and issue-intake identities after repeated attempts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-033, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "actionable cleanup instructions" specified with enough structured fields and checklist references for an operator to identify residue without exposing raw secrets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-028, Contract §Blocked Preflight Result]
- [ ] CHK007 Is `mutation_status: "not_mutated"` used consistently as a pre-mutation failure signal rather than a generic error label after partial seed writes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Modes, Contract §Seed Evidence Validation Rules]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the FocusEngine boundary clear that SPEC-009B infers external cleanup residue from observable Mission Control/OpenClaw/GitHub/operator evidence and does not add a FocusEngine table or cleanup path? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [ ] CHK009 Is failed workflow-contract import/readiness behavior clear enough to preserve existing `workflow_templates` instead of manually inventing or partially overwriting runtime policy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Implementation Approach]
- [ ] CHK010 Are unexpected operational failures distinguishable from blocked preflight, contract readiness failure, and verification failure through documented exit codes and redacted payloads? [Clarity, Contract §Exit Codes, Constitution §XIII]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec, plan, data model, and CLI contract consistently require residue preflight before any seed mutation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Plan §Summary, Plan §Implementation Approach, Contract §Modes]
- [ ] CHK012 Do cleanup requirements consistently require backup/export-first operator action while prohibiting automatic deletion, unlinking, or mutation of non-Mission-Control state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-013, Workflow §Design Concept]
- [ ] CHK013 Do contract-readiness requirements align between the spec and plan so stale workflow aliases or missing required slugs fail closed before import/apply? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Plan §Implementation Approach, Data Model §Workflow Family Templates]
- [ ] CHK014 Do retry and idempotency requirements align with the plan's transactional seed approach and stable identity keys without implying rollback of unrelated residue? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-033, Plan §Implementation Approach, Data Model §State Transitions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can blocked preflight be objectively measured with before/after row and file snapshots showing unchanged non-Mission-Control residue? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005, Contract §Seed Evidence Validation Rules]
- [ ] CHK016 Can failed contract readiness be objectively measured through missing required slugs, source path, `mutation_status: "not_mutated"`, and preserved existing workflow-template state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Contract Readiness Failure]
- [ ] CHK017 Can seed rerun safety be objectively measured with stable identity counts after two runs and no duplicate Product Line, department, assignment, workflow, flag, governance, or issue-intake records? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-013, Data Model §State Transitions]
